tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content. Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (13.4:1).

tokens.name: color-bordeaux
tokens.usage: Fine wine prestige, aging complexity, varietal depth,. Used as text on `.header-certification`, `.logo-icon`, `.btn-enroll`. 9.0:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-champagne-gold
tokens.usage: Label elegance, bottle sophistication, celebration,. Used as text on `.logo`, `.nav-link`, `.credential-badge`. 1.2:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-cellar-stone
tokens.usage: Underground aging, vault walls, temperature stability,. Used as text on `.stat-label`, `.characteristic-label`. 4.5:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: color-label-cream
tokens.usage: Wine label background, tasting note cards, certificate. Used as text on `.badge-reserve`. 1.0:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-oak-barrel
tokens.usage: Aging barrels, French oak influence, toasted notes,. Used as text on `.stat-change`, `.card-price`, `.form-hint`. 4.2:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: color-burgundy
tokens.usage: Grand cru excellence, sommelier authority, Pinot Noir. Used as text on `.page-subtitle`, `.table-region`, `.form-description`. 10.8:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-deep-wine
tokens.usage: Used as text on `body`, `.card-tasting-notes`, `.data-table td`. 13.4:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-vintage-gold
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.nav-link:hover`, `.section-action`, `.card-appellation`; border on `.nav-link:hover`. 2.0:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.
